source_snapshot.procedure: Install approved Intel MLC; temporarily reserve4000 hugepages; run full MLC and collect logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: Idle/loaded latency, bandwidth ratios, node bandwidth and cache-to-cache results match DIMM spec.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL omits hugepage restoration and acceptance profile.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires approved artifact, NUMA/profile, complete output and restoration.

old_problem: The review kept the case pending because MLC artifact/profile, hugepage binding and project performance thresholds were not yet populated.
disposition_reason: The source defines the workload family and required metric coverage. Under the approved parameterization rule, DIMM/NUMA profile, signed MLC artifact, hugepage capacity and versioned thresholds are Runtime Project Configuration. ED-15 is enforced by prohibiting PASS until every bound threshold exists; no engineering-decision question remains in the Review-layer design.
decision_basis: Directly read Performance row5 all18 XLSX cells and history2584.
Preserved full MLC coverage: idle latency, read/write-ratio bandwidth, node bandwidth, loaded latency and cache-to-cache latency.
Made4000 hugepages a capacity-checked temporary mutation with baseline, authorization and restoration rather than silently changing host state.
No package installation, hugepage change or benchmark execution occurred.

test_case.test_name: Parameterized Intel MLC full DIMM/NUMA performance validation
test_case.purpose: Measure the complete approved MLC metric set on the bound DIMM/CPU/NUMA configuration and compare each result with its versioned project specification.
required_package: Approved Intel MLC archive/version/hash/license and compatibility matrix
Hugepage size/current consumers and authorization for temporary4000-page reservation
Versioned per-metric thresholds/tolerances and thermal/ECC abort limits
test_case.test_command: Capture topology, power state, idle load, health and current HugeTLB values; calculate capacity and, only with change approval, temporarily set `nr_hugepages=4000`; verify allocation; execute the pinned MLC binary with the bound affinity/repetition profile; retain complete raw output and telemetry; restore original HugeTLB and host state; compare every bound metric to its matching threshold.
test_case.expected_result: The approved MLC run completes with full output; all bound idle/loaded latency, bandwidth-ratio, node-bandwidth and cache-to-cache metrics meet their versioned limits; no ECC/thermal/system fault occurs and original hugepage state is restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS is allowed only when the runtime profile and every metric threshold are approved before execution and all comparisons pass. Missing threshold/profile, partial output, incompatible topology, allocation failure, health event or restoration failure is BLOCKED/FAIL, never an inferred PASS.
safety_gate: Confirm MLC license/compatibility and a quiescent performance window.
Calculate4000-page memory cost and protect existing hugepage consumers.
Abort on memory pressure, ECC/thermal fault or topology mismatch.
Preserve and restore original hugepage, affinity and power settings.
expected_evidence: MLC artifact hash/version/license and exact invocation
Complete raw MLC output plus temperature/ECC telemetry
Versioned threshold matrix and per-metric comparison
test_case.recovery: On allocation, benchmark or health failure, stop, retain logs, restore original hugepage/affinity/power state and verify memory/ECC/system health before release; do not substitute a shorter or partial profile.

source_conflict.reason: The source consistently requires a full MLC run; absent project limits are runtime bindings, not contradictory source intent.

blocked.reason: Review design is complete; execution blocks safely if package, profile, capacity or thresholds are not bound.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Bind topology/profile, approved MLC artifact, hugepage capacity/authorization, all metric thresholds and abort limits before execution.
pending.owner: Project performance owner supplies runtime profile/spec; test engineer captures and compares evidence.
pending.unlock_condition: No review decision remains; execution requires all runtime bindings and cannot pass with an absent threshold.

project_authority: Project performance limits remain mandatory runtime inputs but no longer justify Engineering Decision Pending.
